metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code mods: guardrails, git, cost, productivity, quality, dashboards and more.

plugins.name: mod-store
plugins.description: An in-terminal app store: browse, search, install and update every Claude Mod from GitHub.

plugins.name: secret-shield
plugins.description: Blocks edits and writes that would commit API keys, tokens or private keys.

plugins.name: env-guard
plugins.description: Protects .env files, SSH keys and credential stores from being read or modified.

plugins.name: rm-rf-guard
plugins.description: Blocks catastrophic shell commands like rm -rf /, mkfs, dd to disks and chmod -R 777.

plugins.name: force-push-guard
plugins.description: Forbids force-pushing to protected branches and suggests --force-with-lease.

plugins.name: prod-guard
plugins.description: Stops production-affecting commands (terraform apply, kubectl on prod, DROP TABLE) unless explicitly allowed.

plugins.name: redactor
plugins.description: Masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model ever reads them.

plugins.name: path-jail
plugins.description: Allows writes only inside the project root, resolving symlinks and .. tricks.

plugins.name: curl-pipe-guard
plugins.description: Blocks piping downloaded scripts straight into a shell.

plugins.name: dependency-sentinel
plugins.description: Flags typosquatted or brand-new packages before npm, pip or cargo installs them.

plugins.name: lockfile-guard
plugins.description: Prevents hand-editing lockfiles; they must change through the package manager.

plugins.name: git-status-line
plugins.description: Shows the current branch, ahead/behind and dirty file count in the status line.

plugins.name: auto-checkpoint
plugins.description: Snapshots your work tree before every editing turn and lets you /rollback to any checkpoint.

plugins.name: commit-composer
plugins.description: /commit writes a Conventional Commit message from your staged diff and commits it.

plugins.name: branch-namer
plugins.description: /git-branch creates a well-named git branch from a short task description.

plugins.name: main-branch-warn
plugins.description: Warns you the moment Claude starts editing files directly on main or master.

plugins.name: diff-pane
plugins.description: A live pane listing changed files with +/- line counts, updated after every edit.

plugins.name: pr-describer
plugins.description: /pr-desc drafts a pull request title and description from your branch diff.

plugins.name: conflict-helper
plugins.description: Detects merge-conflict markers and walks you through resolving each one.

plugins.name: co-author-stamp
plugins.description: Adds configurable Co-authored-by trailers to commits Claude makes.

plugins.name: gitignore-guard
plugins.description: Warns before node_modules, build output, OS junk or huge files get staged.

plugins.name: cost-meter
plugins.description: Live session cost estimate in the status line, from real token usage.

plugins.name: token-budget
plugins.description: Set a token or dollar budget per session; get warned at 80% and stopped at 100%.

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: A slim band above the prompt showing how full the context window is.

plugins.name: cache-hit-meter
plugins.description: Shows what share of input tokens came from the prompt cache.

plugins.name: turn-timer
plugins.description: Times every turn and tells you when one runs long.

plugins.name: big-read-guard
plugins.description: Stops full reads of huge files and nudges toward offset/limit or grep.

plugins.name: output-trimmer
plugins.description: Trims huge command outputs to head, tail and error lines before they flood the context.

plugins.name: daily-spend
plugins.description: Tracks spend per day and week across sessions with a /spend report.

plugins.name: model-advisor
plugins.description: Suggests a cheaper model when your prompt is simple, and a stronger one when it is hard.

plugins.name: compact-coach
plugins.description: Suggests /compact at natural breakpoints, before the context gets tight.

plugins.name: quote-selection
plugins.description: /quote pastes your mouse selection into the prompt as a Markdown quote.

plugins.name: prompt-snippets
plugins.description: Type :review:, :tests: or your own shortcodes and they expand into full prompts.

plugins.name: todo-pane
plugins.description: A live pane of Claude's current task list with progress.

plugins.name: focus-timer
plugins.description: A Pomodoro timer in the status line with focus and break cycles.

plugins.name: scratchpad
plugins.description: A persistent per-project notes pane you can type into without leaving Claude Code.

plugins.name: recent-files
plugins.description: /recent lists the files read and edited in this session, newest first.

plugins.name: copy-last
plugins.description: /copy-last copies Claude's last answer (or its last code block) to the clipboard.

plugins.name: prompt-history
plugins.description: /history searches every prompt you have sent across sessions and reuses one.

plugins.name: quick-commands
plugins.description: Short aliases like /t, /l and /b that run your test, lint and build commands.

plugins.name: idle-nudge
plugins.description: Reminds you about uncommitted changes after a stretch of inactivity.

plugins.name: auto-format
plugins.description: Formats every file Claude edits with the right formatter for its language.

plugins.name: lint-on-save
plugins.description: Runs the linter on each edited file and hands the errors straight back to Claude.

plugins.name: test-watch
plugins.description: Runs the tests related to what changed and shows pass/fail in the status line.

plugins.name: typecheck-gate
plugins.description: Type-checks the project at the end of every editing turn so errors never slip by.

plugins.name: no-skip-tests
plugins.description: Blocks Claude from silencing tests with .skip, .only, xit or skip markers.

plugins.name: todo-tracker
plugins.description: Notices every TODO, FIXME and HACK Claude adds and lists them at turn end.

plugins.name: debug-catcher
plugins.description: Warns when console.log, print, debugger or dbg! statements are left in code.

plugins.name: no-any
plugins.description: Flags new any types, @ts-ignore and eslint-disable comments as Claude writes them.

plugins.name: file-size-watch
plugins.description: Warns when an edited file grows past a size that hurts readability.

plugins.name: test-first
plugins.description: A TDD mode: no production code changes until a test has been written or changed.

plugins.name: tool-timeline
plugins.description: A timeline pane of every tool call with duration, status and input summary.

plugins.name: files-touched
plugins.description: A pane of every file read, edited or created in the session, with counts.

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: /session-stats shows a dashboard of turns, tools, tokens, cost, duration and files.

plugins.name: subagent-monitor
plugins.description: Watch running subagents live: type, status, duration and last activity.

plugins.name: error-feed
plugins.description: Collects every failed command and tool error in one pane.

plugins.name: activity-heatmap
plugins.description: A heat map of when you use Claude Code, by hour and weekday.

plugins.name: bash-history
plugins.description: /bash-history lists recent shell commands Claude ran, with exit status and duration.

plugins.name: web-trail
plugins.description: /sources lists every page Claude fetched or searched this session.

plugins.name: permission-log
plugins.description: Keeps a log of every tool call that was denied, and why.

plugins.name: token-sparkline
plugins.description: A sparkline of tokens per turn right above the prompt.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Injects your team's style guide (STYLE.md) into the system prompt automatically.

plugins.name: language-lock
plugins.description: Makes Claude always answer in your language while keeping code in English.

plugins.name: concise-mode
plugins.description: /concise toggles short, to-the-point answers.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: /enhance rewrites your draft prompt into a precise, well-scoped request.

plugins.name: ticket-linker
plugins.description: Turns ticket references like ABC-123 or #42 into links and context for Claude.

plugins.name: date-context
plugins.description: Gives Claude the current date, time zone, branch and OS on every prompt.

plugins.name: persona-switch
plugins.description: /persona switches Claude between reviewer, architect, teacher and other roles.

plugins.name: explain-level
plugins.description: /eli5, /normal and /expert set how deep Claude's explanations go.

plugins.name: stack-detector
plugins.description: Detects your stack and gives Claude the right conventions for it.

plugins.name: prompt-lint
plugins.description: Gently flags vague prompts like 'fix it' and suggests what to add.

plugins.name: done-chime
plugins.description: Plays a chime when a long turn finishes.

plugins.name: speak-summary
plugins.description: Reads a one-line summary of what Claude did out loud when a turn ends.

plugins.name: permission-ping
plugins.description: Pings you with a sound and toast when Claude is waiting on your approval.

plugins.name: error-buzz
plugins.description: A short buzz when a command or test run fails.

plugins.name: webhook-notify
plugins.description: Posts to Slack, Discord, Teams or ntfy when a long task finishes.

plugins.name: desktop-notify
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude finishes or needs you.

plugins.name: long-run-alert
plugins.description: Alerts you when a single command has been running too long.

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: /ci-watch follows your GitHub Actions run and tells you the moment it passes or fails.

plugins.name: break-reminder
plugins.description: Reminds you to stand up and stretch every 50 minutes of active work.

plugins.name: celebrate
plugins.description: Celebrates when failing tests go green again.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: /decide records an Architecture Decision Record in docs/decisions.

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Writes a dated journal entry of what was done when the session ends.

plugins.name: glossary
plugins.description: Teaches Claude your project's vocabulary and injects definitions when you use the terms.

plugins.name: bookmark
plugins.description: /bookmark saves the last answer; /bookmarks lists and reuses them.

plugins.name: resume-brief
plugins.description: Shows what you were working on last time when a new session starts.

plugins.name: lessons-learned
plugins.description: When Claude fixes a mistake, offers to save the lesson to CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: codebase-map
plugins.description: /map builds a compact map of your repository and gives it to Claude.

plugins.name: snippet-vault
plugins.description: Save and reuse code snippets across projects with /save-snippet and /snippet.

plugins.name: link-vault
plugins.description: Collects every URL from the conversation into one list.

plugins.name: recall
plugins.description: Gives Claude a recall tool to search your saved notes, decisions and journal.

plugins.name: changelog-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section up to date as you commit.

plugins.name: readme-sync
plugins.description: Warns when public APIs, CLI flags or env vars change but the docs do not.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: /standup summarises what you did yesterday, from git history, ready to paste.

plugins.name: review-agent
plugins.description: Adds a dedicated code-reviewer subagent and a /review command.

plugins.name: license-header
plugins.description: Adds your license header to every new source file Claude creates.

plugins.name: issue-drafter
plugins.description: /issue turns the current conversation into a well-structured GitHub issue.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff writes a handoff note so a teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.

plugins.name: i18n-guard
plugins.description: Flags hard-coded user-facing strings in UI components.

plugins.name: migration-guard
plugins.description: Prevents editing database migrations that already exist; write a new one instead.

plugins.name: codeowners-hint
plugins.description: Shows who owns a file (from CODEOWNERS) as Claude edits it.

plugins.name: react-doctor
plugins.description: Catches React hook mistakes as Claude writes them: missing effect deps, setState in render, conditional hooks.

plugins.name: next-guard
plugins.description: Flags missing or needless "use client" and server-only imports leaking into client components in Next.js.

plugins.name: venv-guard
plugins.description: Blocks pip install outside an active virtualenv so system Python stays clean.

plugins.name: node-version-check
plugins.description: Warns when your Node version doesn't match .nvmrc, .node-version or package.json engines.

plugins.name: django-migrate-watch
plugins.description: After Django model changes, checks for missing migrations and offers to create them.

plugins.name: go-mod-tidy
plugins.description: Runs go mod tidy when Claude changes Go imports, so go.mod and go.sum stay in sync.

plugins.name: strict-types
plugins.description: Adds declare(strict_types=1) to new PHP files and from __future__ import annotations to new Python files.

plugins.name: schema-sync
plugins.description: After Prisma or Drizzle schema edits, regenerates the client and warns when a migration is missing.

plugins.name: env-example-sync
plugins.description: Keeps .env.example in sync with the environment variables your code actually reads.

plugins.name: monorepo-scope
plugins.description: Detects which monorepo package you're in and scopes test, lint and build commands to it.

plugins.name: docker-lint
plugins.description: Flags Dockerfile smells: :latest tags, running as root, apt without cleanup, ADD instead of COPY.

plugins.name: k8s-dry-run
plugins.description: Turns kubectl apply into a server-side dry run with a diff you approve first.

plugins.name: terraform-plan-pane
plugins.description: Shows terraform plan as a clear pane of resources to create, change and destroy.

plugins.name: ci-yaml-check
plugins.description: Checks edited GitHub Actions workflows and warns about actions not pinned to a version.

plugins.name: port-check
plugins.description: Before a dev server starts, tells you if the port is already taken and by which process.

plugins.name: dev-server-pane
plugins.description: Starts your dev server in the background and shows its errors in a live pane.

plugins.name: cloud-cost-warn
plugins.description: Warns before commands that create expensive cloud resources like GPU instances or large databases.

plugins.name: log-tail
plugins.description: /tail follows a log file or container in a live pane, with an errors-only filter.

plugins.name: docker-prune-guard
plugins.description: Blocks docker system prune -a --volumes and volume deletion that can wipe local databases.

plugins.name: deploy-checklist
plugins.description: Shows a pre-deploy checklist (tests, branch, changelog) and asks you to confirm before deploying.

plugins.name: sql-safety
plugins.description: Flags UPDATE and DELETE without WHERE in .sql files and in queries inside your code.

plugins.name: query-explain
plugins.description: /explain-query runs EXPLAIN on your local database and explains the plan in plain words.

plugins.name: seed-guard
plugins.description: Blocks database seed, reset and drop commands unless DATABASE_URL points at your own machine.

plugins.name: schema-pane
plugins.description: A pane of your local database's tables and columns, ready to hand to Claude as context.

plugins.name: n-plus-one-hint
plugins.description: Spots database queries inside loops, the classic N+1 problem, as Claude writes them.

plugins.name: migration-namer
plugins.description: Gives new migrations consistent, descriptive, timestamped names.

plugins.name: query-result-cap
plugins.description: Adds a LIMIT to ad-hoc SELECTs Claude runs in psql, mysql or sqlite so results don't flood the context.

plugins.name: backup-before-migrate
plugins.description: Dumps your local database before every migration so a bad one is one command away from undo.

plugins.name: csv-peek
plugins.description: /peek shows a CSV or JSONL file's columns, sample rows and inferred types without reading the whole file.

plugins.name: fixture-factory
plugins.description: /fixtures generates realistic test data that matches your schema or types.

plugins.name: a11y-guard
plugins.description: Flags accessibility misses as Claude writes UI: images without alt, unlabeled buttons, clickable divs.

plugins.name: screenshot-check
plugins.description: After UI edits, takes a Playwright screenshot of the page and shows it to Claude.

plugins.name: bundle-size-watch
plugins.description: Compares bundle size after each build and warns when it grows.

plugins.name: css-token-guard
plugins.description: Flags hard-coded hex colors and pixel values where your design tokens should be used.

plugins.name: lighthouse-run
plugins.description: /lighthouse runs Lighthouse on a URL and shows performance, a11y, SEO and best-practice scores in a pane.

plugins.name: heavy-asset-warn
plugins.description: Warns when large images, videos or fonts are added to the project.

plugins.name: storybook-nudge
plugins.description: Reminds you to add a story when Claude creates a new component without one.

plugins.name: contrast-checker
plugins.description: Checks that the colors Claude changes in CSS meet WCAG AA contrast.

plugins.name: dark-mode-check
plugins.description: Flags colors added without a dark-mode variant in projects that support a dark theme.

plugins.name: component-catalog
plugins.description: /components lists your existing UI components so Claude reuses them instead of creating duplicates.

plugins.name: http-client
plugins.description: /http sends a request and shows the formatted response in a pane, like a tiny Postman in your terminal.

plugins.name: openapi-sync
plugins.description: Warns when your API routes change but openapi.yaml doesn't.

plugins.name: url-allowlist
plugins.description: Restricts WebFetch to the domains you allow.

plugins.name: offline-mode
plugins.description: /offline blocks every network call — fetches, curl, installs, git push — until you turn it back on.

plugins.name: mock-server
plugins.description: /mock starts a fake API server from your OpenAPI spec so you can build the frontend before the backend.

plugins.name: rate-limit-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from hammering external APIs with curl loops.

plugins.name: jwt-decode
plugins.description: /jwt decodes a JSON Web Token locally — header, claims, expiry — without sending it anywhere.

plugins.name: status-check
plugins.description: /service-status checks whether GitHub, npm, PyPI or the Anthropic API are having an outage before you blame your code.

plugins.name: graphql-context
plugins.description: Gives Claude a compact summary of your GraphQL schema when you work on queries and resolvers.

plugins.name: curl-to-code
plugins.description: /curl2code turns a curl command into fetch, axios, Python requests or Go code.

plugins.name: scope-lock
plugins.description: /scope locks Claude to the files you name; edits outside the scope are blocked.

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: /second-opinion has a different model critique Claude's last answer or plan.

plugins.name: parallel-explore
plugins.description: /explore sends three subagents to investigate different parts of the codebase and merges their findings.

plugins.name: subagent-cap
plugins.description: Caps how many subagents can run at the same time.

plugins.name: task-queue
plugins.description: /queue lines up prompts that run one after another whenever Claude is free.

plugins.name: night-shift
plugins.description: Runs your queued tasks at a scheduled time, like overnight, and leaves you a report.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Stops Claude when it repeats the same failing command three times and suggests a different approach.

plugins.name: self-check
plugins.description: At the end of each editing turn, has the model double-check it actually did what you asked.

plugins.name: edit-limit
plugins.description: Asks for confirmation when a single turn tries to modify more than N files.

plugins.name: agent-presets
plugins.description: Ready-made subagents for focused jobs: debugger, test writer, doc writer and migrator.

plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: /explain-diff explains in plain words what changed in the last turn and why.

plugins.name: quiz-me
plugins.description: /quiz asks you questions about the code Claude just wrote, to check you really understand it.

plugins.name: learning-mode
plugins.description: Claude explains the why behind each change and leaves small TODOs for you to complete yourself.

plugins.name: onboarding-tour
plugins.description: /tour walks a newcomer through the repository step by step.

plugins.name: command-coach
plugins.description: Suggests Claude Code commands and mods that fit the way you work.

plugins.name: shortcut-tips
plugins.description: One tip a day about Claude Code shortcuts and features you might not know.

plugins.name: why-log
plugins.description: Records why each file was changed; /why shows the reasoning behind any file's edits.

plugins.name: cheatsheet
plugins.description: /cheat shows a quick reference for git, docker, regex, tmux and more, offline.

plugins.name: pair-mode
plugins.description: Claude proposes, you type: edits become diffs you apply yourself, for deliberate practice.

plugins.name: skill-tracker
plugins.description: Tracks which languages and tools you've worked with each week.

plugins.name: license-checker
plugins.description: Warns when a dependency with a copyleft license (GPL, AGPL) lands in a permissively licensed project.

plugins.name: pii-in-logs
plugins.description: Flags log statements that print emails, passwords, tokens or other personal data.

plugins.name: data-map
plugins.description: /data-map lists where your code collects, stores and sends personal data — a head start for GDPR.

plugins.name: tracker-guard
plugins.description: Blocks adding analytics and tracking SDKs that haven't been approved.

plugins.name: no-upload
plugins.description: Blocks commands that upload files to external services like pastebins and file-sharing sites.

plugins.name: crypto-guard
plugins.description: Flags weak cryptography: MD5 or SHA1 for passwords, Math.random for tokens, ECB mode, hard-coded IVs.

plugins.name: sbom
plugins.description: /sbom generates a software bill of materials with every dependency and its license.

plugins.name: audit-trail
plugins.description: Writes every action Claude takes to an append-only JSONL audit log.

plugins.name: vuln-scan
plugins.description: After installs, runs npm audit or pip-audit and shows any vulnerabilities in a pane.

plugins.name: copyright-guard
plugins.description: Flags pasted code that carries someone else's license or copyright header.

plugins.name: benchmark-compare
plugins.description: /bench runs your benchmarks before and after a change and compares the numbers.

plugins.name: slow-test-flag
plugins.description: Points out your slowest tests after each test run.

plugins.name: flaky-detector
plugins.description: Detects tests that pass and fail at random and keeps a list of the suspects.

plugins.name: leak-hint
plugins.description: Flags event listeners, intervals and subscriptions created without cleanup.

plugins.name: outdated-deps
plugins.description: /outdated shows stale dependencies and how risky each upgrade is.

plugins.name: profile-run
plugins.description: /profile runs a command under a profiler and shows the hottest functions.

plugins.name: net-retry
plugins.description: Automatically retries commands that failed because of a temporary network error.

plugins.name: disk-guard
plugins.description: Warns when the disk is nearly full before builds, installs and docker pulls.

plugins.name: regression-guard
plugins.description: Remembers which tests passed at the start of the session and warns if any of them now fail.

plugins.name: watch-mode-guard
plugins.description: Blocks watch-mode and never-ending commands run in the foreground, where they'd hang the turn.

plugins.name: mod-maker
plugins.description: /new-mod scaffolds a new Claude Code mod with manifest, hooks, test and README, ready to fill in.

plugins.name: mod-doctor
plugins.description: /mod-doctor checks your installed mods for outdated versions, conflicts and load errors.

plugins.name: mod-profiles
plugins.description: Switch between sets of mods — work, personal, demo — with one command.

plugins.name: settings-sync
plugins.description: Exports and imports your mods' configuration so you can move it between machines.

plugins.name: quiet-mode
plugins.description: /quiet silences toasts and sounds from every mod while you focus.

plugins.name: achievements
plugins.description: Unlock achievements as you work: first commit, 100 green test runs, a week-long streak and more.

plugins.name: streaks
plugins.description: Shows your consecutive days of coding with Claude in the status line.

plugins.name: soundpack
plugins.description: Sound packs for Claude Code events: minimal, retro or nature.

plugins.name: daily-goal
plugins.description: /daily-goal sets today's goal, keeps it in view above the prompt and asks at day's end if you got there.

plugins.name: session-replay
plugins.description: /replay steps through the session — prompts, tool calls, edits — in a pane, like a video timeline.
